panels.description: Alex follows the hidden pipe through a cramped service trench behind the pump station. The pipe descends through the foundation; dry taps and the tightening non-recognizable queue remain visible above. Show the uphill infrastructure spine climbing away in the distance. Leave upper-right clear.

The newer pipe enters an open foundation breach. Adjacent and clearly separate is the concrete-sealed pit-rim mine entrance with faded hazard stripes and a forbidden marker. Beyond the breach: damp rock, rusted rail, and darkness. Leave upper-left and upper-right clear.
Alex shines his work light through the open breach. Condensation beads on the newer pipe and an old amber gauge glows below. Reserve upper-left for Bi11bot and bottom-right for Alex.

Alex slings the tool bag over his shoulder and steps into the maintenance breach. Bi11bot folds into a compact bundle with one amber eye open. Keep the distant display isolated at the far-left bottom edge. Reserve upper-left for Alex, upper-right for Bi11bot, and bottom-right for the final reply; the display area must not overlap any balloon.

items.speaker: QUEUE WORKER
items.text: Last warning! If the line doesn’t recover, the remaining allocation goes uphill!

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: It’s not a route. It’s a maintenance gap.
